children: Diageo's CFO departure will most likely be viewed negatively, Edward Mundy at Jefferies says in a note. CFO Nik Jhangiani played a key role in shaping the spirits company's strategy and is regarded well by investors, Mundy writes. He had a strong focus on execution, growth and cash delivery, Mundy adds. But there are unlikely to be broader implications in the medium term for the company or its turnaround plan, he adds. Shares are down 0.73% at 1,626.50 pence. (aimee.look@wsj.com)
